description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession's selectKeyId method, specifically testing the behavior of selecting key IDs in a media session, including success, failure, duplicate selection prevention, and error handling.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionSelectKeyIdTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the selectKeyId method of MediaKeySession, inheriting from MediaKeySessionTestBase.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Tests that selectKeyId executes successfully and returns MediaKeyErrorStatus::OK.

methods.name: DoNotSetTheSameKeyTwice
methods.description: Ensures that the same key is not selected twice consecutively.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Verifies that selectKeyId returns failure when the underlying session mock indicates failure.

methods.name: SaveKeyAfterSuccessfulOperationOnly
methods.description: Checks that the key is only saved if the select operation succeeds.

methods.name: OnErrorFailure
methods.description: Tests that if onError is called during selectKeyId, the method returns failure.
